quests.title: Doric's Iron Delivery
quests.description: Gather 3 Iron Ore from the hills and deliver them to Doric.

startDialogue.speaker: Doric
startDialogue.text: Greetings, traveller! My forge has run cold and I'm desperately short on iron. Could you fetch me 3 pieces of Iron Ore from the hills?

choices.text: Where can I find iron ore?

hint.speaker: Doric
hint.text: Check the rocky slopes and outcrops along the hills east of the sanctuary. Look for dark mineral veins.

choices.text: Sounds like too much work right now.

decline.speaker: Doric
decline.text: Fair enough. The forge will be here whenever you're ready.

accept.speaker: Doric
accept.text: Splendid! Bring me 3 pieces of Iron Ore and I'll make sure you're well rewarded.

progressDialogue.speaker: Doric
progressDialogue.text: Any luck finding that iron ore? Remember to search the rocky hills to the east.

turnInDialogue.speaker: Doric
turnInDialogue.text: Ah, look at the quality of this ore! Just what my anvil needed. Thank you, traveller! Here is your reward.

completedDialogue.speaker: Doric
completedDialogue.text: Thanks again for the iron, friend! The forge has never burned brighter.

quests.title: The Missing Chronicle
quests.description: Recover 2 Lost Chronicle Pages scattered near the camp ruins.

startDialogue.speaker: Wise Old Man
startDialogue.text: Ah, young adventurer! A sudden gust of wind scattered pages from my ancient chronicle across the sanctuary. Would you lend an old man a hand?

lore.speaker: Wise Old Man
lore.text: Fascinating tales of the Third Age! Dragons, ancient gods, and grand fortresses. Much too precious to be lost to the mud.

choices.text: I will find them for you.

decline.speaker: Wise Old Man
decline.text: A pity. Let us hope the wolves don't develop a taste for ancient history.

accept.speaker: Wise Old Man
accept.text: Splendid! Bring back 2 of the scattered pages and I shall reward your diligence.

progressDialogue.speaker: Wise Old Man
progressDialogue.text: Have you found those pages yet? Look around the old walls and ruins nearby.

turnInDialogue.speaker: Wise Old Man
turnInDialogue.text: Marvellous work! Every page intact. You have the keen eye of a true adventurer. Take this for your troubles!

completedDialogue.speaker: Wise Old Man
completedDialogue.text: Back to my readings! Thank you once again for your assistance.

rewards.text: 200 Gold Coins & Wisdom of the Ages
